turns.speaker: doctor
turns.orig: नमस्ते, बैठिए। बताइए, क्या तकलीफ़ है?
turns.en: Hello, please sit. Tell me, what is the problem?

turns.speaker: patient_or_attender
turns.orig: डॉक्टर, पेट के दाएं तरफ दर्द होता है, तेल वाला खाना खाने के बाद। तीन महीने से।
turns.en: Doctor, I get pain on the right side of my stomach after eating oily food. For three months now.

turns.speaker: patient_or_attender
turns.orig: Vomiting दो बार हुई पिछले महीने। बुखार नहीं है।
turns.en: Vomiting happened twice last month. No fever.

turns.speaker: other
turns.orig: Sir, BP is 128 over 82. Weight 71 kilos.
turns.en: Sir, BP is 128 over 82. Weight 71 kilos.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.orig: Okay. Did you get the ultrasound done?
turns.en: Okay. Did you get the ultrasound done?

turns.speaker: patient_or_attender
turns.en: Yes sir, the report is here.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.orig: The scan shows multiple stones in the gallbladder, the biggest about 12 millimetres, and the wall is a little thick.
turns.en: The scan shows multiple stones in the gallbladder, the biggest about 12 millimetres, and the wall is a little thick.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.orig: This is what is causing your pain. My advice is to remove the gallbladder by laparoscopic surgery.
turns.en: This is what is causing your pain. My advice is to remove the gallbladder by laparoscopic surgery.

turns.speaker: patient_or_attender
turns.orig: ऑपरेशन? ज़रूरी है क्या डॉक्टर? दवाई से नहीं हो सकता?
turns.en: Operation? Is it necessary, doctor? Can it not be done with medicines?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.orig: Medicines only settle the pain for some time. The stones stay, and the attacks will come back. I would advise doing it in the next month or two.
turns.en: Medicines only settle the pain for some time. The stones stay, and the attacks will come back. I would advise doing it in the next month or two.

turns.speaker: patient_or_attender
turns.en: Sir, how much will it cost?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.orig: The package is around eighty to ninety thousand rupees. The counsellor outside will give you the exact estimate.
turns.en: The package is around eighty to ninety thousand rupees. The counsellor outside will give you the exact estimate.

turns.speaker: patient_or_attender
turns.orig: हॉस्पिटल में कितने दिन रहना पड़ेगा?
turns.en: How many days will I have to stay in the hospital?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.orig: One night, sometimes two. You are back to routine work in a week.
turns.en: One night, sometimes two. You are back to routine work in a week.

turns.speaker: patient_or_attender
turns.orig: ठीक है डॉक्टर, हम घर पर बात करके बताते हैं।
turns.en: Okay doctor, we will talk at home and let you know.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.orig: Sure. Avoid fried food till then. Come back if the pain is severe or there is fever.
turns.en: Sure. Avoid fried food till then. Come back if the pain is severe or there is fever.

turns.speaker: other
turns.orig: Sir, the next patient is waiting.
turns.en: Sir, the next patient is waiting.
